contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONS[--] ; R/ VIC[TORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]

: Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably a copy of two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, possibly Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONS[--]. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths. Reverse inscription: VIC[TORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]. In exergue: possibly [-]TR. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.7mm, Weight: 1.37gms, die axis: 6
